name: r80_sm_currentonly_shadow_v006
purpose: Bounded CPU shadow diagnostic of the legacy-prior provenance gap. This is a standard current-only recipe comparison, not a pure causal pretraining-only ablation and not a proposed live-model replacement.

live_state_snapshot.use: Copy the 299 lineage aliases and frozen v006 chunk history during preparation only.
live_state_snapshot.reason: The source state is live and may advance to a later data version; future launch must bind the copied shadow state plus immutable v006 protocol, manifest, receipt, and model metadata rather than require this old live-state hash.

model.normalization: fit the exact 1773 current profile_train rows only

shadow_protocol.phase_index_difference: With no legacy phase, current_profile uses phase_i=0 in script.symmetry_training._epoch_order; live v006 used phase_i=1 after legacy_pretrain. Thus minibatch order differs even with the same seed, and the comparison is not a pure one-factor causal estimate of pretraining alone.

frozen_data.copy_policy: Copy only paths referenced by the v006 cumulative manifest; verify source and destination SHA-256 against source_sample_sha256/source_rad_sha256. Preserve manifest and receipt bytes exactly.

prospective_selected32.saved_live_v006_predictions: Copy the prospective guided manifest byte-for-byte; it contains the frozen live-v006 curves, scores, model hash, predicted_before_hfss=true, and data-v006 binding.
prospective_selected32.required_training_exclusion: All 32 pattern_sha256 values must be absent from the 2641-row training manifest; preparation rejects any intersection.
prospective_selected32.future_shadow_prediction_gate: After all three shadow members complete, load_current_predictor must save and hash all 32 shadow curves and existing-scorer outputs before any evaluator opens an HFSS truth artifact. This is held-label-unread prediction generation; the queued HFSS work may already be physically running or complete.
prospective_selected32.timing_distinction: The copied live-v006 predictions are prospective and carry predicted_before_hfss=true. New shadow predictions must not claim predicted_before_hfss; their allowed claim is saved before shadow evaluator truth read.
prospective_selected32.truth_policy: Do not copy, inspect, or bind completed result stores during preparation or prediction generation.

prediction_score_definitions.wm_of_ensemble_mean: Apply WM once to the ensemble-mean response curve.
prediction_score_definitions.factory_score: Use script.symmetry_sm_pool._score_rows with the frozen PoolConfig; this is the mean of per-member WM values and is not generally WM of the ensemble mean.
prediction_score_definitions.lcb_score: Use the same existing scorer and frozen PoolConfig uncertainty penalty.

classification_diagnostics: false predicted positive counts for wm_of_ensemble_mean > 0
false predicted positive counts for factory_score > 0
false predicted positive counts for lcb_score > 0
same_868_profile_holdout.comparison: Report shadow beside the already-frozen live-v006 summary; do not select a model from this holdout.

same_selected32.comparison: Shadow predictions versus frozen live-v006 predictions on identical pattern order and immutable pattern hashes.

predeclared_evaluation.claim_limit: Current-only removes the unmatched legacy prior as a bounded diagnostic. Holdout MAE alone cannot authorize switching the live model, and any result remains confounded by the phase-index minibatch-order change.

execution_policy.implementation: Reuse script.symmetry_training.train_version and load_current_predictor without source edits.
